mapper.select: SELECT s.salon_id, s.owner_id, s.salon_name, s.address, s.phone_number, s.description, s.average_rating, s.image_url, MIN(se.price) AS minimum_price, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.latitude, s.longitude FROM Salons s LEFT JOIN Services se ON se.salon_id = s.salon_id WHERE s.activation_status = 'active' GROUP BY s.salon_id, s.owner_id, s.salon_name, s.address, s.phone_number, s.description, s.average_rating, s.image_url, s.created_at, s.updated_at ORDER BY s.average_rating DESC, s.salon_id DESC
